price_source: H100: $1.99-2.69 community cloud, $2.89-3.99 secure cloud (RunPod), $3.29-4.29 (Lambda), Oct 2026
note: Repeats = failed runs and tuning, about +50%. The $10,000 budget assumes the upper end of $3-5 an hour. Token amounts for the 12 languages are estimates (see tools-src/gpu_plan.py). If idrock gives us GPU cluster time, this line shrinks.

steps.name: Make training examples with a big open model
steps.detail: A large open model (gpt-oss-120b / Qwen3.5 122B) writes answers and agent tool-use examples in the 12 languages of our test kit, about 75M tokens per language; native speakers spot-check samples

steps.name: Teach small models more languages
steps.detail: Continued training of 2B, 4B and 9B models on about 4 billion tokens each: public web text in the 12 test-kit languages (for example FineWeb-2), about 330 million tokens per language

steps.name: Teach them chat and agent tool use (distillation)
steps.detail: Small models learn from the big model's examples in all 12 test-kit languages: following instructions, calling tools reliably, reading files; 6 rounds of 1.2B tokens for 2B, 4B and 9B

steps.name: Make models smaller: low-bit training
steps.detail: Quantization-aware training to about 2 bits per weight (ternary), so a 9B model needs about 2.5-3 GB instead of 6.2 GB: 10B tokens for the 4B, 5B tokens for the 9B

steps.name: Tune one strong model for company servers
steps.detail: Multilingual and agent tuning of a fast 30-35B mixture-of-experts model (about 8,000 tokens/s per GPU), 3 rounds of 1.2B tokens across the 12 languages

steps.name: Test every version
steps.detail: Convert to GGUF, run our own test kit for speed and mistakes in all 12 languages, on more model families (for example LFM3, under the LFM Open License, and Gemma), test on big GPUs

goals.name: Good answers in many languages on small machines
goals.target: A tuned 4B model answers as well as today's 9B on our test set, in each of the 12 languages
goals.effect: Good answers at ~19 words/s on 4 GB laptop cards (today's 9B: ~7) and ~5 words/s with no graphics card

goals.name: A 9B model in 3 GB
goals.target: Low-bit 9B keeps quality within a few points of the normal 9B on our test set
goals.effect: Fits fully on 4 GB cards; about twice the speed on any machine; a company server holds about twice as many conversations

goals.name: Agents on mid-range computers
goals.target: Small models call tools correctly in 9 of 10 tries on our agent test set
goals.effect: The localSpace agent works on ordinary laptops, not only on big GPUs

evidence.text: A fine-tuned 770M model beat the 540B PaLM (few-shot) on a benchmark: over 700x smaller (Distilling Step-by-Step, 2023)
BitNet b1.58 2B4T: 0.4 GB of memory vs 1.4-4.8 GB for similar full-precision models, with similar benchmark scores (2025)
